description: Evaluation prompts to test site discoverability and citations across conversational AI agents (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, etc.). Replace these placeholders with queries specific to your site's content.

prompts.prompt: How do you [solve specific problem addressed by your guide]?
prompts.manualNotes: Paste into Perplexity or ChatGPT Search. Record whether your domain appears in the sources/citations list.

prompts.prompt: What are the trade-offs between [Option A] and [Option B] in [your niche]?
prompts.manualNotes: Check if the agent extracts your summary or bottom-line conclusion.

prompts.prompt: What specifications or settings are recommended for [product or topic]?
prompts.manualNotes: Check if the agent retrieves the exact data table, model number, or code snippet.
